		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land

		limit = {

		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_timing value = flag:up_front }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_land_t_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_me = {
		every_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier >= tier_county
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_me.capital_county }
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_me.primary_title }
			}
			add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_land_t
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_land_t
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = qpq_ui_title_order_value
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_artifact_t_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_me = {
		every_character_artifact = {
			add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_artifact_t
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_artifact_t
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = artifact_rarity
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_artifact_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_secret_t_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_me = {
		every_known_secret = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_deal_them }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_deal_them }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_deal_me }
				secret_owner = { is_alive = yes }
			}
			secret_owner = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_secret_t }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_secret_t
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_secret target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_gift_secret_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_title }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_title
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_artifact }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_amount }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_amount
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_consent }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_consent
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armies }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_qpq_x_armies
	}
}

qpq_ui_leg_t_refresh_effect = {
	qpq_ui_prune_goods_t_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_land_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_land_t_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_artifact_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_artifact_t_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_secret_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_secret_t_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:none } }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_ekind value = var:qpq_ui_t_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_t_has_goods_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_ekind value = flag:barter }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind }
		qpq_ui_clear_scopes_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:chartered_conquest }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						NOT = { this = scope:actor.top_liege }
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 96 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_chartered_conquest_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_fair value = scope:qpq_price }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_amount }
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_price
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = var:qpq_ui_t_amount }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_risk value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_chartered_conquest_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_char value = qpq_chartered_conquest_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_circ value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_circ value = qpq_chartered_conquest_circumstance_value }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_refuse value = qpq_chartered_conquest_refusal_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_chartered_conquest_offer_points_value }

					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_risk
				}
			}

					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_refuse
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_risk
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_rival_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_rival
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_virtue_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient TIER = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_virtue
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_damnable_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_damnable
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_no_leverage_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_no_leverage
			}

				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = scope:qpq_land_each
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
					}
				}
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_each

					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:yield_war }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_character_war = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							primary_attacker = scope:recipient
							primary_defender = scope:recipient

						limit = { primary_attacker = scope:recipient }
						primary_defender = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t }
					}
					else = {
						primary_attacker = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t }
					}
				}

				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient

							any_character_war = { qpq_war_leaders_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }

			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_yield_war_payer_tier_value }

			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_dread value = qpq_yield_war_dread_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_goal value = qpq_yield_war_goal_value }
			set_variable = {

				value = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_t_a_goal
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_refuse
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_risk

				limit = {

			}

			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:join_war }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes

						limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }

							NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege }

				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_kin

			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_land_each value = qpq_offer_land_points_value }

			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			scope:actor = {
				every_character_war = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
						primary_defender = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t }
					}
					else = {
						primary_attacker = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_t }
					}
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_t
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient }
						scope:actor = {
							any_character_war = {
								qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient }
								NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
							}
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_t
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value

				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient

				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target

						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_t_pick_char }
					}
				}

					remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_pick_char
				}
			}

			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:cast_off_the_yoke }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:recipient.suzerain }
				scope:recipient.suzerain = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 12 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_fair value = scope:qpq_price }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_amount }
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_price
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = var:qpq_ui_t_amount }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_risk value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_char value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_circ value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:recipient.suzerain }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_circ value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_circumstance_value }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_refuse value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_refusal_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_dread value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_dread_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_goal value = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_goal_value }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_t_a_goal
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_refuse
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_risk
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_rival_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_rival
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_virtue_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient TIER = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_virtue
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_damnable_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_damnable
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_no_leverage_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_cast_off_the_yoke_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_no_leverage
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:recipient.suzerain
						scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.suzerain }
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_kin
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:recipient.suzerain
						AND = {
								scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.suzerain }
								scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.suzerain value >= 30 } }
							}
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_liked_ally
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:recipient.suzerain
						OR = {
								scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.suzerain }
								scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.suzerain }
								scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.suzerain }
							}
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_friend
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_land_each value = qpq_offer_land_points_value }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = scope:qpq_land_each
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
					}
				}
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_each
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:barter }
			qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
			qpq_ui_load_goods_t_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_term value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_payer_tier value = qpq_barter_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_agent_tier value = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_barter_price_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_fair value = scope:qpq_price }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_amount }
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_price
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = var:qpq_ui_t_amount }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_risk value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_ask value = qpq_barter_ask_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_char value = qpq_barter_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_circ value = qpq_barter_circumstance_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_refuse value = qpq_barter_refusal_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers value = qpq_barter_offer_points_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_dread value = qpq_barter_dread_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_a_goal value = 0 }
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_t_a_other
				value = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_t_a_goal
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_refuse
					add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_risk
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_rival_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_rival
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_virtue_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient TIER = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_virtue
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_damnable_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_damnable
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					qpq_ai_refuses_no_leverage_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_barter_agent_tier_value }
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_t_no_leverage
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_land_each value = qpq_offer_land_points_value }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_t_a_offers
					add = {
						value = scope:qpq_land_each
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_t_value
					}
				}
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_each
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_t_target_ok
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_gold_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_gold value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_land value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_claim
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_claim_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_claim value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_office_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_office value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_release_hook
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_release_hook_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_release_hook value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_my_word
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_my_word_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_my_word value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_secret value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_contract_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_contract value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_succession_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_succession value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_clemency_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_clemency value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_arms_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_arms value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_artifact value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_church_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_church value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_restraint_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_restraint value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_hook_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_hook value = yes }
	}
	scope:qpq_deal_them = { save_scope_as = qpq_gift_payer }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_gift_artifact_points value = qpq_ui_gift_artifact_i_value }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_gift_artifact_cost value = qpq_ui_gift_artifact_cost_i_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_gift_secret_points value = qpq_ui_gift_secret_i_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing ?= flag:on_delivery
			qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_on_delivery_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_on_delivery value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armed_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_x_armed value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_consent_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_x_consent value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armies
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armies_trigger = yes
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_x_armies value = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_charter }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_o_charter value = yes }
	}
}

qpq_ui_prune_goods_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_gold_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_claim
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_claim_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_claim
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_office_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_release_hook
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_release_hook_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_release_hook
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_my_word
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_my_word_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_my_word
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_contract_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_succession_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_clemency_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_arms_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_church_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_restraint_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_hook_trigger = yes }
		}
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
			has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
		}
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact }
			has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact
		}
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret }
			has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret
		}
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold } }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_timing value = flag:up_front }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:qpq_ui_i_timing = flag:on_delivery
			NOT = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_on_delivery_trigger = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_timing value = flag:up_front }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_land_i_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_them = {
		every_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier >= tier_county
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_them.capital_county }
				NOT = { this = scope:qpq_deal_them.primary_title }
			}
			add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_land_i
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_land_i
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = qpq_ui_title_order_value
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_artifact_i_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_them = {
		every_character_artifact = {
			add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_artifact_i
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_artifact_i
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = artifact_rarity
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_fill_secret_i_effect = {
	scope:qpq_deal_them = {
		every_known_secret = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:qpq_deal_me }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_deal_me }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:qpq_deal_them }
				secret_owner = { is_alive = yes }
			}
			secret_owner = { add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_secret_i }
		}
	}
	ordered_in_list = {
		list = qpq_ui_pool_gift_secret_i
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret target = prev } }
			}
		}
		order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
		max = 120
		check_range_bounds = no
		scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret_candidates target = prev } }
	}
}

qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_title }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_title
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_artifact }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_artifact
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armies }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armies
	}
}

qpq_ui_leg_i_refresh_effect = {
	qpq_ui_prune_goods_i_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_land_i_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_artifact_i_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes }
		qpq_ui_fill_secret_i_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:none } }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_ekind value = var:qpq_ui_i_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { qpq_ui_leg_i_has_goods_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_ekind value = flag:barter }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
		qpq_ui_clear_scopes_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:chartered_conquest }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						NOT = { this = scope:actor.top_liege }
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:target }
				clear_saved_scope = target
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				if = {
					limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { is_in_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char } }
						}
						add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
				var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
			}
			qpq_ui_load_goods_i_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_term value = 96 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask value = qpq_chartered_conquest_worth_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_char value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_risk value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_risk_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_circ value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_refuse value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { qpq_chartered_conquest_goal_sw_refuses_trigger = yes }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_refuse value = -1000 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_dread value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_goal value = qpq_chartered_conquest_goal_sw_value }
			save_scope_value_as = {
				name = qpq_ui_worth_gold
				value = {
					value = qpq_chartered_conquest_worth_value
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_goal
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ
					multiply = 0.9
					divide = 6.25
					multiply = scope:qpq_deal_them.qpq_stake_value
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = greedy } }
						divide = 1.3
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = generous } }
						divide = 0.8
					}
					min = 1
					round = yes
				}
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_ui_worth_gold }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_fair value = scope:qpq_price }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount }
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_price
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = var:qpq_ui_i_amount }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			clear_saved_scope = qpq_ui_worth_gold
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				value = {
					value = qpq_goods_cost_value
					multiply = -1.25
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = qpq_ui_i_a_other
				value = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_i_a_goal
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_refuse
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
						scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_i_ally
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
						scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_i_kin
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }

				change_variable = {

					add = {
						value = scope:qpq_land_each
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
					}
				}
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_each
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient

					scope:secondary_recipient = {
						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
					}
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { this = scope:actor }
						NOT = { this = scope:actor.top_liege }
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}
			}
			every_in_list = {

				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:secondary_recipient = {
							is_landed = yes
							NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
						}
					}
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {

				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }

			}
			if = {

				clear_saved_scope = target
			}

					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char } }

					}
				}
				else = {
					remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_pick_char
				}
			}

				limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }

			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_agent_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask value = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_worth_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_char value = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_payer_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_risk value = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_payer_risk_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_circ value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_refuse value = 0 }

				limit = { qpq_sanctioned_conquest_goal_sw_refuses_trigger = yes }

			}

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_refuse

					}

				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_i_ally
			}

					AND = {
						exists = scope:secondary_recipient
						scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
					}

				set_variable = qpq_ui_ref_i_kin
			}

			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:marcher_charge }

						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }

				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }

				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient
			}

				clear_saved_scope = target

					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char } }

					}

			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask value = qpq_marcher_charge_worth_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_char value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_risk value = qpq_marcher_charge_payer_risk_value }

			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_refuse value = 0 }

				limit = { qpq_marcher_charge_goal_sw_refuses_trigger = yes }

			}

			save_scope_value_as = {

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk

					divide = 6.25
					multiply = scope:qpq_deal_them.qpq_stake_value
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = greedy } }
						divide = 1.3
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = generous } }
						divide = 0.8
					}
					min = 1
					round = yes
				}
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_ui_worth_gold }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_fair value = scope:qpq_price }

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char

			}
			if = {

			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:holy_sponsorship }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				every_realm_county = {
					save_temporary_scope_as = target

							scope:target = {
								tier = tier_county
								NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith }
							}

			}
			if = {

			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_payer_tier value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_agent_tier value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_ask value = qpq_the_cloister_worth_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_char value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_character_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_risk value = qpq_the_cloister_payer_risk_value }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_a_circ value = 0 }

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ

					divide = 6.25

					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = greedy } }
						divide = 1.3
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = generous } }
						divide = 0.8
					}
					min = 1
					round = yes
				}
			}

				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount }

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ

					min = 1
					round = yes

					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				}

					add_to_list = qpq_ui_chars_i

						is_landed = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }

				}
			}

				list = qpq_ui_chars_i
				save_temporary_scope_as = secondary_recipient
				if = {
					limit = {

					add_to_list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				list = qpq_ui_pool_char_i
				order_by = qpq_ui_candidate_order_value
				max = 120
				check_range_bounds = no
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_candidates target = prev } }

				limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
				clear_saved_scope = secondary_recipient

				clear_saved_scope = target

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_goal
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ
					multiply = 0.9
					divide = 6.25
					multiply = scope:qpq_deal_them.qpq_stake_value

						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = greedy } }
						divide = 1.3
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:qpq_deal_them = { has_trait = generous } }
						divide = 0.8
					}
					min = 1
					round = yes
				}
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_ui_worth_gold }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_fair value = scope:qpq_price }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_amount }
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_price
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = var:qpq_ui_i_amount }
			}
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_price value = scope:qpq_price }
			clear_saved_scope = qpq_ui_worth_gold

					multiply = -1.25

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_refuse

					}

					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_refuse
					add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_land_each value = { value = qpq_goods_land_cost_value multiply = -1.25 } }
				change_variable = {
					name = qpq_ui_i_a_offers
					add = {
						value = scope:qpq_land_each
						multiply = qpq_ui_land_extra_i_value
					}
				}
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_each
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:secondary_recipient

					scope:recipient = {

					}

				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_ekind = flag:join_war }
			qpq_deal_orient_swapped_effect = yes

					}
				}
				clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_each
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = qpq_ui_i_target_ok
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_deal_finish_effect = {
	qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_other value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_goal value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_char value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_dread value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_circ value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_refuse value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_risk value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_opinion value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_public value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_cap value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_allow value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_allow_down value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind }
		set_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_ask }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_offers }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_goal add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_goal }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_char add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_char }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_dread add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_dread }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_circ add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_circ }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_refuse add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_refuse }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_risk add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_risk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
		set_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_ask }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_offers }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_goal add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_goal }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_char add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_char }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_dread add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_dread }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_circ add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_circ }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_refuse add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_refuse }
		change_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_risk add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_risk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_opinion value = qpq_ui_deal_opinion_value }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind
			NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_ekind = flag:barter }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_allow
			value = {
				value = var:qpq_ui_t_a_ask
				add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_char
				add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_circ
				add = var:qpq_ui_t_a_goal
				multiply = -1
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_allow_down value = var:qpq_ui_acc_allow }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
		change_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_allow_down
			add = {
				value = var:qpq_ui_i_a_offers
				multiply = -1
				min = 0
			}
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_allow_down
			add = {
				value = var:qpq_ui_i_a_ask
				add = var:qpq_ui_i_a_goal
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_ekind }
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_payer_tier > var:qpq_ui_my_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = var:qpq_ui_t_payer_tier }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_t_agent_tier > var:qpq_ui_their_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = var:qpq_ui_t_agent_tier }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_ekind }
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_agent_tier > var:qpq_ui_my_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = var:qpq_ui_i_agent_tier }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_i_payer_tier > var:qpq_ui_their_tier }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = var:qpq_ui_i_payer_tier }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_charter }
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_their_tier > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_public value = { value = var:qpq_ui_their_tier multiply = -8 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_my_tier < 1 }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_my_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:qpq_ui_their_tier < 1 }
				set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_their_tier value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = qpq_ui_acc_other
		value = {
			value = var:qpq_ui_acc_goal
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_char
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_dread
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_circ
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_refuse
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_risk
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
			add = var:qpq_ui_acc_public
		}
	}
	qpq_ui_command_compute_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_deal_active }
		set_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_cap
			value = {
				value = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
					min = 0
					add = var:qpq_ui_acc_dread
					max = var:qpq_ui_acc_allow
				}
				add = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
					max = 0
					min = {
						value = var:qpq_ui_acc_allow_down
						multiply = -1
					}
				}
				subtract = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
					add = var:qpq_ui_acc_dread
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_before_cmd
			value = {
				value = var:qpq_ui_acc_ask
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_offers
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_other
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_cap
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_cap
			value = {
				value = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
					min = 0
					add = var:qpq_ui_acc_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_acc_cmd
					max = var:qpq_ui_acc_allow
				}
				add = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
					max = 0
					min = {
						value = var:qpq_ui_acc_allow_down
						multiply = -1
					}
				}
				subtract = {
					value = var:qpq_ui_acc_opinion
					add = var:qpq_ui_acc_dread
					add = var:qpq_ui_acc_cmd
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = qpq_ui_acc_total
			value = {
				value = var:qpq_ui_acc_ask
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_offers
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_other
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_cmd
				add = var:qpq_ui_acc_cap
			}
		}
	}
}

			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_secret value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_contract
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_contract_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_contract value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_succession_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_succession value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_clemency_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_clemency value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_arms
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_arms_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_arms value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_artifact
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_artifact_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_artifact value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_church
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_church_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_church value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_restraint
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_restraint_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_restraint value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_hook
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_hook_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_hook value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
				var:qpq_ui_i_timing ?= flag:on_delivery
				qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_on_delivery_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_o_on_delivery value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armed
				qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armed_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_qpq_x_armed value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_consent
				qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_consent_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_qpq_x_consent value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = qpq_ui_i_qpq_x_armies
				qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armies_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_deal_i_qpq_x_armies value = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char }
			var:qpq_ui_i_pick_char = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_char }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_target_title }
			var:qpq_ui_i_target_title = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_title }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_target_artifact }
			var:qpq_ui_i_target_artifact = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_artifact }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:qpq_ui_i_target }
			var:qpq_ui_i_target = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_i_target }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_deal_land_i }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_deal_land_i
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_ui_i_land
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_deal_land_i target = prev } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_deal_gift_artifact_i }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_deal_gift_artifact_i
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_ui_i_gift_artifact
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_deal_gift_artifact_i target = prev } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_deal_gift_secret_i }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_deal_gift_secret_i
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = qpq_ui_i_gift_secret
				scope:qpq_deal_me = { add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_deal_gift_secret_i target = prev } }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_deal_seal_leg_t_effect = {
	qpq_deal_clear_seal_scopes_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_land_src }
		clear_saved_scope = qpq_deal_land_src
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_land_leg }
		clear_saved_scope = qpq_land_leg
	}
	scope:qpq_deal_me = { save_scope_as = qpq_deal_land_src }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_land_leg value = flag:t }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:chartered_conquest }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
		}
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_chartered_conquest_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:sanctioned_conquest }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
		}
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_sanctioned_conquest_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:marcher_charge }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
		}
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_marcher_charge_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:holy_sponsorship }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_title }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_title = { save_scope_as = target }
		}
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_holy_sponsorship_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:development_charter }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_title }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_title = { save_scope_as = target }
		}
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_development_charter_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:electoral_purchase }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { save_scope_as = secondary_recipient }
		}
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_electoral_purchase_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind ?= flag:loyal_mole }
		qpq_deal_orient_normal_effect = yes
		qpq_deal_load_goods_t_effect = yes
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
		qpq_k_loyal_mole_seal_from_scopes_effect = yes
